screens.S_ENTRY: Outside the app: launcher, a link or shared content from another app, a Quick Settings tile, the panic app, a system broadcast, a backup
screens.S_PROCESS: The application is created and the process runs: every component starts from here
screens.S_EXIT: Aegis leaves the screen: the activity or the task is finished, no vault is shown
screens.S_INTRO_WELCOME: Intro slide 1 (Welcome): Import button, Next and Previous
screens.S_INTRO_PICKER: Intro slide 2 (security picker): none, password, biometrics; Next and Previous
screens.S_INTRO_SETUP: Intro slide 3 (security setup): password fields or biometric setup; Next and Previous
screens.S_SCANNER: QR scanner (ScannerActivity): the camera preview; the camera switch icon when two lenses exist
screens.S_AUTH: Unlock screen (AuthActivity): password field, unlock button, biometric button when a biometric slot exists, Back
screens.S_LIST: Main screen with the entry list (vault loaded): toolbar, lock icon, FAB, group chips
screens.S_SETTINGS_MAIN: Settings main list (MainPreferencesFragment rows): the categories that open a sub-page
screens.S_MAIN_STOPPED: Main screen stopped (Home key, another app or a system screen on top)
